title: Value, Risk, and Recoverability: An Interpretable Order-Level Prioritization Framework for Service Recovery in E-Commerce
venue: Digital 6(3):57 (MDPI)
prediction_time: stated: at order time, and after delivery but before the review (in-fulfillment model)
headline_metrics: out-of-sample AUC 0.61 at order time; 0.72 with in-fulfillment signals
note: [evidence: full text] [dataset: Olist confirmed, 93,663 delivered orders] Strictly temporal hold-out (trained on orders placed before 1 May 2018, tested on later orders). The in-fulfillment model adds the actual delivery time, the delay against the estimate and a late-delivery flag (Section 2.4), which are resolved at delivery; removing the delay-related variables lowers ROC-AUC from 0.724 to 0.658 (Section 3.2). These inputs are admissible for the window after delivery and before the review that the authors name. First coded from the abstract, recoded from the full text during revision. The only reviewed study reporting a moment-specific, temporally validated estimate - closest to a leakage-free benchmark.
